shots.title: Reproduce or characterize Windows EPERM lock-open contention (#515)
shots.notes: Confirmed #515 was a Windows full-suite lock acquisition failure: focused atomic-write tests passed, but the original full-suite evidence showed `EPERM` opening the `.lock` file.

shots.title: Harden withFileLockSync lock acquisition for transient EPERM (#515)
shots.notes: `withFileLockSync` now treats Windows `EPERM`/`EACCES` during lock open as transient acquisition states, retrying within the existing timeout while preserving timeout diagnostics.

shots.title: Stabilize atomic-write concurrency regression under full-suite load (#515)
shots.notes: Added a Windows EPERM lock-open regression and stress-reran the focused atomic-write suite before the full-suite gate.

conditions.description: The first full-suite run exposed a one-off `auto-card --include-untracked` status failure, but the focused auto-card suite, the auto-card+doctor pairing, and the next full-suite run all passed.
`CODEBASE.md` is ignored in this repo; `slope map --check` confirmed the local map is current after the new test file count.

training.description: Windows lock acquisition can report transient `EPERM`/`EACCES` instead of only `EEXIST` when another process is racing lock creation/removal.
training.outcome: The file-lock loop now retries those Windows acquisition errors under the same timeout as existing lock contention.

training.description: Intermittent full-suite failures should be rerun at the focused, neighboring, and full-suite levels before becoming new roadmap work.
training.outcome: The unrelated auto-card signal was recorded as validation wind rather than promoted into a new sprint from a non-repeatable failure.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A careful reliability shot. The fix is small, but the validation loop mattered because the bug only appeared under full-suite pressure.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep transient Windows lock errors inside the same bounded acquisition loop; do not turn them into silent success or unbounded waiting.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The atomic flake stayed gone, while an unrelated auto-card status blip appeared once and then refused to repeat.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The recovery phase is now ready for the release sprint with the noisy Windows reliability items cleaned up.

bunker_locations: Windows file lock creation can surface `EPERM` or `EACCES` for lock-open races.
Full-suite-only failures need focused and neighboring reruns before becoming new roadmap work.
yardage_book_updates: `src/cli/atomic-write.ts` retries Windows `EPERM`/`EACCES` lock-open errors within the existing timeout loop.
`tests/cli/atomic-write-lock.test.ts` covers transient Windows `EPERM` during lock acquisition.
`tests/cli/atomic-write.test.ts` continued to pass under repeated concurrent-process stress.
